blocked_candidates.reason: FPA permits parents to agree on the child-benefit recipient; official address is not an unconditional entitlement rule.
Marriage Act household-debt joint liability excludes a monetary loan. Buying food with borrowed money does not itself bind the other spouse.
Parental allowance is not invariably below salary; minimum and earnings calculation rules make the absolute comparison false.
Home-care allowance excludes a municipal childcare place, not every private childcare arrangement. Scheduled 2027 changes also require later review.
FPA expressly permits flexible care allowance alongside municipal or private early childhood education; the blanket full-time exclusion is false.
Forced marriage may meet trafficking or other offence definitions; the source categorical classification omits offence-specific conditions.
Possible criminal responsibility for a guardian omission needs the specific duty, knowledge and offence conditions. These were not established sufficiently for a standalone card.
Acknowledgment is not the only route: parenthood can also be established judicially. Acknowledgment and legal confirmation must not be conflated.
The standalone Maternity Act was replaced by the Parenthood Act 775/2022. The substantive two-parent rule is covered separately.
Always mother omits the legal parenthood-designation rules associated with confirmation of gender. Ordinary birth-parent rules are covered with qualifiers.
The parentage action and representation of the child need clarification; the source implies the mother has unrestricted personal standing.
Unclear cause requires competent medical/legal assessment; the source makes an unqualified automatic-obduction claim.
Burial permit and release do not require completion of every final cause-of-death result, which can take months.
Absolute exclusion of medical autopsy without family permission omits the statutory authority-permission route; ordinary consent covered separately.
Every person donor is too broad: capacity, minors, known wishes and medical suitability matter. Documenting wishes is covered without this absolute rule.
Insurance normally takes priority, but legal aid can cover qualifying applicants insurance deductible and other statutory exceptions.
Children must be heard according to development before twelve too; twelve is not the start of a general right to have views considered.
Joint acquisition does not always establish equal ownership shares. The separate statutory presumption for disputed movable ownership is qualified in a card.
Funeral-cost support is complementary assistance from the wellbeing services county/Helsinki, not an ordinary FPA funeral-cost benefit.

verification_sources.findings: 320 total days, 160 each, transfer conditions, partial allowance and earnings-related/minimum payment. No unconditional salary comparison.
Maximum 63 transferred days from an ordinary 160-day quota.
40 working days, usual start 14–30 days before due date and 154-day pregnancy condition.
Under-three child, reduced work up to 30 hours or 80 percent; daycare is allowed. Parents may alternate care.
Normally school years one and two and up to 30 hours work; other qualifying educational cases exist.
Municipal place exclusion, care/benefit coordination and announced changes from January 2027. Cards describe current rules, not a guarantee for 2027.
Recipient can be agreed; under-seventeen benefit, tax exemption and conditional cross-border coordination.
Confirmed maintenance, nonpayment or economic inability, one liable parent and exceptional pending-amount cases.
District-court petition, reflection period, two-year separation exception and arrangements after divorce.
Separate ownership, conditional statutory separation and compensation. No automatic equal division of all assets.
Recognition, confirmation and judicial establishment are distinct; ordinary parenthood consequences.
Parenthood Act replacing former separate maternity/paternity rules; standing and representation need care.
Legal designation of parenthood may change with gender confirmation.
Custody decisions, child welfare and age/development-sensitive consideration of child views.
Private reports may be anonymous; professionals have reporting obligations.
Seek competent authority help for wrongful cross-border removal/retention.
Shelter availability, anonymity and interpreting; children may accompany and no prior injury required.
Seri services irrespective of gender with age/time eligibility; under-sixteens use pediatric pathway. No universal eligibility asserted.
Death certification, medical versus forensic autopsy and practical release/burial arrangements.
Police responsibility for forensic death investigation; competent assessment rather than family self-certification.
Inheritance order excludes cousins; estate inventory normally within three months; extension, listed debts and forced share rules.
Court explains Marriage Act household debt rule excludes monetary loans; do not publish source food-loan example.
Judgment cites ministry requirement of licensed doctor for non-medical boy circumcision. Card expressly concerns guidance and safeguards.
Municipal official guidance: licensed doctor, guardian written consent, child refusal, pain relief and no public funding for non-medical circumcision.
Insurance-first principle has legal-aid deductible exception for eligible applicants.
Specialist victim assistance and criminal-law classification require qualifications.
Funeral assistance is complementary social assistance, rather than ordinary FPA expenditure.

other_source_issues.reason: Family reunification qualified by child safety and best interests.
No-work rule qualified through separate partial parental allowance question.
Avvittring card concerns net marital property with exceptions, not literal equal division of every asset.
Sole petition starts reflection on service; wording corrected using court procedure.
Compensation for cohabitant contribution is called gottgorelse, not matrimonial adjustment.
Temporary does not mean brief; duration and review depend on child welfare.

coverage_note: Source IDs include context and consolidation links. Coverage concerns selected learning points, not every detail in every linked sentence. Source itself was preserved. CORE priorities were not reduced for obsolete claims.
